images.name: 自然索引
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, high-fidelity game UI DESIGN BOARD. Input image 1 is the LOCKED EXISTING GAME BACKGROUND, not a style inspiration: insert this exact image without repainting it, recoloring it, cropping it, pixelizing it or changing any tree, window, mountain, building, water, sun, bird, cup or book. Design new interface overlays only. 

Create one beautiful landscape board, preferably 4:3 or 3:2, titled "37 自然索引 / NATURE INDEX", brand "Little Elsewhere". Upper about 70% shows the complete reference game viewport with a carefully designed small but FUNCTIONALLY RICH collecting interface; lower about 25% is an OFF-WHITE DESIGN-SPEC STRIP OUTSIDE THE GAME, containing three enlarged UI state/detail examples connected by small arrows. Keep a narrow title header. This is one coherent proposal, not multiple styles.

Interaction architecture: a classification-first naturalist index. In the main viewport place a finely drawn bottom navigation rail on the window ledge, five small specimen icon tabs "鸟 4/10" "兽 1/4" "虫 2/7" "风景 3/8" "奇遇 1/21", with an understated cream-and-sage selection line on the bird tab. To the lower right a compact feeding indicator (seed pictogram, 68%) and tiny focus/music controls. Upper left a small weather/date chip "晨曦 · 晴". A slender right-edge pull-tab "发现 +1". One modest selected-bird contextual label near the existing left branch bird, with a thin connection line: "麻雀" and "第 3 次来访", a tiny bookmark button. Do not obstruct the central river or mountains. Total resting UI about 10% of viewport, no huge open panel. It must have purposeful original icons, clear hierarchy and useful status/progress, not only three generic text buttons.

External bottom design strip: three enlarged interface cards, with clean concise Chinese titles. 1 "分类浏览": category tabs above a 2x3 grid with distinct original little sparrow/kingfisher/owl portraits and 3 unknown silhouettes, a subtle "4/10". 2 "观察记录": selected sparrow card with first-seen date, tiny perch/feeding activity icons, and button "加入珍藏". 3 "熟悉的来客": five-step familiarity progression with three steps filled and a small feather keepsake reward card "再来 2 次". These are interaction-detail examples OUTSIDE the game view, not permanent screen furniture. Short clear text only, no fake paragraphs.

Visual treatment: refined Japanese naturalist editorial UI, clean warm ivory paper, soft sage green, dark grey-green ink, a restrained muted ochre indicator. Thin ruled lines, tiny hand-drawn specimen icons, subtle paper texture, ample spacing, calm purposeful typography. Charming but sophisticated game UI, highly legible. Avoid glossy cards, glassmorphism, heavy ornaments, stitched vines, wooden plaques, huge books, fantasy decoration, rainbow, neon, thick borders, app dashboard styling. The BACKGROUND MUST remain the identical reference image; all new aesthetic choices apply only to UI and the external design strip.

images.name: 来客信箱
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, finished high-fidelity game INTERACTION DESIGN BOARD, one landscape 3:2 image. Title "38 来客信箱 / VISITOR LETTERS". Small brand "Little Elsewhere". Input image 1 is an EXISTING LOCKED GAME SCREENSHOT; use it as the main viewport unchanged. Preserve every outdoor feature, existing colors, lighting, composition and pixel-painted artwork exactly. Do not redesign the landscape. Only add UI overlays and an external design-spec strip beneath it.

Board composition: narrow off-white header, upper 68% a complete main game screenshot, bottom 27% an off-white strip OUTSIDE the game with three enlarged interface state examples joined by fine arrows. This lower strip is not permanent game HUD. The game viewport should remain spacious, with small functional UI taking only about 8–12% along its edges. Rich interaction organization, not three generic buttons. One contextual notification at most.

Proposal architecture is a gentle post-visit inbox and relationships. Main viewport upper-left a small folded letter icon with "来客信箱" and a tiny coral badge "2"; just below a thin date / weather line "周六 · 晴". Lower-left on the existing window ledge, a SMALL horizontal mini inbox with two illustrated visitor portrait chips: "麻雀 · 新留言" and "翠鸟 · 昨日"; scalloped postage edges are tiny, subtle, not ornamental. Lower-right a compact feeding meter "种子 68%" with a small refill plus control. Along the remaining ledge three small icon labels: "图鉴", "观察", "陪伴"; tiny headphone sound control. A small narrow notification slip tucked near the right border "麻雀又来过了" with a feather pictogram and light postmark, no large open letter obscuring the view. Keep the central river, mountains and tree canopy clearly visible.

Bottom detail strip has three purposeful enlarged interactive states with concise readable Chinese labels. First "收到来信": open cream visitor card with a beautifully drawn small sparrow, stamp "NEW", line "今天 08:16", two action buttons "记入图鉴" and "稍后". Second "熟悉的来客": sparrow head portrait, "来访 5 次", a path of five small filled circles with one highlighted stamp, and a tasteful feather keepsake card "一根小羽毛", "收下纪念". Third "回访记录": short neat timeline with 3 rows e.g. "周六 08:16  啄食", "周五 17:40  歇脚", "周四 09:12  初遇", small bird/activity pictograms, and a bookmark / favorite corner button. The loop is arriving visitor -> record -> familiarity -> keepsake, visually obvious.

Style: delicate Japanese stationery and travel-journal interface, cream paper, slate ink, muted sage, a TINY restrained faded red postmark accent. Clean fine borders, excellent spacing, thin handwriting touches for annotations only, clean legible main type, original tiny bird/envelope/seed icons. No heavy vintage texture, no giant stamps, no wooden/vine frames, no thick carved panels, no glossy 3D, no dashboard grids inside game. Not a complete album permanently consuming the scenery. Main view visually quiet; interaction detail lives in the lower design strip. Text must be short and readable, no invented dense paragraphs. Keep background identical to provided reference.

images.name: 天象观测簿
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE highly polished game INTERACTION DESIGN BOARD, landscape 3:2. Title "39 天象观测簿 / SKY WATCH". Small brand "Little Elsewhere". Image 1 is the EXISTING GAME SCREENSHOT and must be treated as a LOCKED IMAGE INSERT, not inspiration to redraw: preserve its exact daytime sky, sun, mountains, river, curved shores, town, left tree, balcony, flowers, food dish, book and mug, unchanged colors and proportions. DO NOT turn the world to night or add aurora to the large viewport. UI design only.

Composition: narrow off-white header, main game screenshot upper about 67–70%, bottom 25–28% external off-white DESIGN STATE STRIP with three enlarged interface panels and fine arrows. Main live HUD occupies 8–12% around edges with very open center. The entire world remains unobscured except modest edge controls. Never a large permanently open guide. Show purposeful coherent control and information depth, not just three text buttons.

This proposal is a rare-event observation journal. Main viewport: upper-left tiny date/weather chip "晨曦 · 晴"; upper-right a compact observation watch module, only about 1/6 screen width, with small moonphase pictogram, "今晚观测" and two minimal condition tags "晴空" "入夜", plus a subtle small notification dot. Along lower window ledge a thin phenomenon timeline with 4 ticked icon moments, labeled "今日" "黄昏" "入夜" "深夜", selected "入夜"; it should feel like a paper astronomical observation ruler, not sci-fi radar. Adjacent compact navigation icons "图鉴", "天象", "观察", "陪伴", tiny sound toggle. A slender right-edge notification "新线索 · 极光" with a bookmark icon, NOT a huge event card. Existing tree birds are unchanged. Keep central mountains and river free of text.

Bottom external strip: three clearly differentiated state examples. First "观测线索": a concise neat clue card with moon/weather/time requirement pictograms, labels "晴夜" "22:00 后" "北方天空", two checkmarked chips, button "提醒我". Make this an intriguing clue system, NOT numerical gambling odds or lootbox. Second "记录奇遇": a collectible AURORA observation card (only this small vignette may show night aurora), with four tiny star rarity marks, "极光" / "首次记录", pin + button "收入图鉴". Third "天象档案": a 2x3 silhouette collection with one aurora card, shooting stars, twin moon shadow, and unknown silhouettes, neat progress "1 / 21", category tabs "天空" "水面" "异象". These lower states are explanatory design examples outside the gameplay view; draw simple arrows showing clues -> discovery -> collection.

Style only in UI: refined Japanese scientific pocket journal, delicate navy ink rules on warm pale ivory, desaturated teal highlights, very small muted gold stars. Subtle paper grain, minimalist engraved celestial pictograms, tight typographic hierarchy, generous whitespace. Calm and collectible, clear iconography, beautiful small illustration vignettes. No purple neon, dark sci-fi HUD, glowing machinery, giant brass astrolabe, ornate fantasy frames, thick borders, excessive saturation or heavy textures. Short legible Chinese text only; no dummy paragraphs. The main scenery MUST stay the original daylight reference with no visual-style change.
